subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six face of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the face having the number '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fdd95deb7357e85cbeb0d9fbb0813969d6183e1bb2157948cf4013199be0162.png]
solution:
In first and second dice 5, 6 are common in both dices.

First dice is rotated 90⁰ anti-clockwise horizontally on the other adjacent side of 5, 6 is '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68516ab1cbda242828b039912211eb91b647f4514703d213b5331c11f39bfe6c.png] 

∴ Here, the opposite face of side '3' is side '1'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"1".**
